text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is a field of computer science that creates machines able to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. A key part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of following clear instructions. Deep learning is a more advanced type of machine learning that uses large neural networks. Today, AI is part of our daily lives. It helps us unlock our phones with our faces, suggests films we might enjoy, translates languages, and even drives cars. AI is not magic; it is powerful software that improves as it processes more information.
